limitations: No new native reproduction of the prepared-cache eviction scenario; ASTRA-CS-003 is High-confidence, not Confirmed.
Confirmed source findings do not imply Android or deployed reproduction; per-finding evidence levels are explicit.
Historical archive restoration after a generation transition has no retained composed acceptance test.
Final integrated budget-enabled live backup/restore/replacement paths remain unverified on the selected candidate.
Thirty-request CPU evidence is head-heavy and aggregate-only; it is not a full-route or provider-billing guarantee.
Two emulator packages are not two independent devices; broad Doze/OEM/power-loss behavior is not established.
Three UI scenarios cover main preview/settings/credential behavior, not every recovery/replacement view or full accessibility.
Retained hashes and build metadata establish consistency, not independent reproducibility of all historical binaries/executions.
The review was systematic but not formal verification or exhaustive parser fuzzing.
